fix.reason: Already fixed on main by 97aea7d307 (MS-1753), which is an ancestor of origin/main. In SelectSubjectViewModel.getDisplayDialogStateIfRequired, the isValidGuid() check now returns before enrolmentRecordRepository.load(), so RealmUUID.from() is never called with non-GUID IDs. The fix still needs to ship in a release (v2026.3.2 does not have it), so consider cherry-picking 97aea7d307 to the release branch.
fix.summary: No change needed: main already skips the enrolment record lookup for non-GUID selected IDs.

items.root_cause: In an MFID CONFIRM_IDENTITY callout the caller sends a selected ID that is not a GUID ('BIOMETRICS_SEARCH_...'); SelectSubjectViewModel.getDisplayDialogStateIfRequired calls enrolmentRecordRepository.load() before its isValidGuid() check, so RealmUUID.from() in RealmEnrolmentRecordLocalDataSource.buildRealmQueryForSubject throws and the app crashes. Fixed on main by commit 97aea7d307 (MS-1753, 2026-11-11) but not in any release yet (v2026.3.2 still has it); no open PR.

fix.reason: Root cause already fixed on origin/main by commit 9f8fd51f9a (MS-1752, 'Ignore finishWithResult from fragment that already was popped from backstack'). In infra/ui-base NavigationResultExt.kt, finishWithResult now returns early when canNavigate(fragment) is false. So a second ConsentFragment finishWithResult (double tap) never sets a ConsentResult under the root result key, and OrchestratorActivity's handleResult<AppResult> cast is never reached. The only crash is on 2024.1.5, which predates the fix. No extra change needed; the fix only has to ship in the next release.
fix.summary: Already fixed on main: NavController.finishWithResult now ignores calls from a fragment that is no longer the current destination (canNavigate guard).

items.root_cause: ConsentFragment calls finishWithResult twice (e.g. double tap); the second ConsentResult is delivered under the root result key while the current destination is already the orchestrator root, and OrchestratorActivity's handleResult<AppResult> listener throws ClassCastException (NavigationResultExt / OrchestratorActivity). Fixed on main by commit 9f8fd51f9a (MS-1752, 2026-11-10), not in any release yet; no open PR.

fix.summary: FingerprintCaptureViewModel.start no longer force-unwraps a null fingerprint config; it logs via Simber, shows the unexpected-error alert, and the fragment skips capture UI setup.

items.root_cause: FingerprintCaptureViewModel.start dereferences configRepository.getProjectConfiguration().fingerprint!!, which was null when the orchestrator restored a fingerprint step after process death right after a config sync, so fingerprint capture crashed. Main still has the unguarded `!!`; no open PR.

fix.summary: Replace runBlocking in FaceCaptureViewModel.saveImage with a suspending withContext on the injected @DispatcherBG dispatcher so bitmap compression and image saving no longer block the main thread during face capture.

items.root_cause: FaceCaptureViewModel.saveImage uses runBlocking on the main thread (called from flowFinished in viewModelScope) to compress the bitmap and write it to disk, blocking the UI long enough to ANR during face capture. Main still has the runBlocking; no open PR.

fix.reason: origin/main already contains PR #1886 (merge 17815420f5, 2026-11-12): Simber.isSkippableException now skips java.util.concurrent.CancellationException (covers JobCancellationException and TimeoutCancellationException from FirebaseAuthManager.getCurrentToken and EventRepositoryImpl.reportException), and EventUpSyncTask rethrows CancellationException before the generic catch. The remaining Crashlytics events come from released versions (<= 2026.3.2) that predate the fix; it will take effect once a release built from main ships.
fix.summary: Already fixed on main by PR #1886; no new change needed

items.root_cause: Broad catch blocks in sync paths log WorkManager cancellations via Simber.e, which records them as non-fatals: FirebaseAuthManager.getCurrentToken ("Failed to get access token"), EventRepositoryImpl.reportException ("Failed to save the event") and EventUpSyncTask ("Failed to upload event scopes"). EventUpSyncTask also swallows the CancellationException (not in isTerminalException) and records the scope as FAILED. Unchanged on main; Simber.shouldSkipThrowableReporting could skip CancellationException, and EventUpSyncTask should rethrow it. Fix merged to main in PR #1886 (2026-11-12, makes Simber skip CancellationException and EventUpSyncTask rethrow it) but not in any release yet (v2026.3.2 predates it); no open PR.

fix.summary: Replace legacy com.google.firebase.ml.vision.DEPENDENCIES meta-data in feature:login with com.google.mlkit.vision.DEPENDENCIES=barcode in infra:camera so Play Services pre-downloads the unbundled barcode module for login and MFID QR scanning

items.root_cause: The unbundled Play Services ML Kit barcode module is not on the device when QR scanning starts (login / MFID QR), so every frame fails with 'Waiting for the barcode module to be downloaded' and DetectQrCodeUseCase logs each failure via Simber.e. feature/login AndroidManifest.xml declares the legacy meta-data key com.google.firebase.ml.vision.DEPENDENCIES instead of com.google.mlkit.vision.DEPENDENCIES, so the module is likely never pre-downloaded; unchanged on main, no open PR.

Two EventSyncMasterWorker runs start concurrently; the second calls closeAllOpenScopes(DOWN_SYNC) and EventRepositoryImpl.closeEventScope deletes the first chain's empty down-sync scope, so BaseEventDownSyncDownloaderWorker.getEventScope finds none and throws IllegalArgumentException('input required'), failing that down-sync run. Still on main; no open PR.

There is a race in FirebaseAuthManager: signOut/initializeCoreProject delete the core FirebaseApp (tryToDeleteCoreApp) while a sync worker calls FirebaseAuth.getInstance(getCoreApp()) in getCurrentToken, which throws "FirebaseApp was deleted". The worker fails gracefully. getCoreApp is still unsynchronised against delete on main. Fix merged to main in PR #1888 (2026-11-12) but not yet released; window events are all on pre-2026 builds.

A single device has a legacy Realm file in format 9 that realm-kotlin cannot upgrade. RealmWrapperImpl.createRealm only deletes and recreates the DB on RLM_ERR_INVALID_DATABASE, not RLM_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_FILE_FORMAT_VERSION, so every background worker fails. Main is unchanged. Fix merged to main in PR #1887 (2026-11-12), not yet released; the affected single device is on 2025.2.0.
